name: Yui Credit Union
description: Yui Credit Union — a business theme for a member-owned credit union. A floating white rounded header bar with outlined pills and one solid pine pill, ruled ledger heads (a hairline, a numbered capital label and one pine italic word) above every section, and a uniform 3:2 pickup row with captions under a rule. A stone ground with white panels, ink text and one small pine accent. The home page opens on an inset branch photograph with the headline below, then continues with ownership, a sample-rate table, a loan calculator, what members use, a member story, the join steps, governance, branches and the journal. Merriweather for headings, Public Sans for reading. Works without any plugin. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.

fonts.role: display: headings, rate figures, numerals, wordmark (Light 300 and Regular 400, Italic 300 for the accent word; Latin subset)
